'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] strike kills eight civilians and injures four others, at a bus stop in [[Toretsk]], according to regional governor [[Pavlo Kyrylenko]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3543369-russians-fire-at-crowded-bus-stop-in-toretsk-eight-dead-three-children-among-injured.html (Ukrinform)]
***[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Amnesty International]] releases a report alleging [[Ukrainian forces]] have endangered civilians by establishing bases and operating weapons systems in residential areas, schools, hospitals, violating international humanitarian law as they turn civilian objects into military targets. [https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2022/08/ukraine-ukrainian-fighting-tactics-endanger-civilians (Amnesty International)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**Thirteen people, including nine civilians, are killed in a militant attack in [[Bam Province|Bam]], [[Burkina Faso]]; thirty-four [[insurgent]]s are also killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/militants-kill-13-attack-burkina-faso-counter-terrorism-operation-2022-08-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**The [[Bank of England]] raises its benchmark [[interest rate]] from 1.25% to 1.75% in its largest single rate hike since 1995. [https://www.reuters.com/business/bank-england-hikes-rates-clamour-contain-spiralling-inflation-2022-02-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed when a truck collides with a commuter bus in [[Central Region (Ghana)|Central Region]], [[Ghana]]. [http://www.uniindia.com/~/at-least-12-killed-in-ghana-road-crash/World/news/2794922.html (UNOI)]
*Three people are killed and a fourth person is seriously injured by a [[lightning strike]] at [[Lafayette Square, Washington, D.C.|Lafayette Square]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/washington-lightning-couple-killed-1.6543311 (CBC)]
*Six people are killed and eight others are injured when [[nurse]] Nicole Linton drove into multiple cars at over 130[[Miles per hour|MPH]] in [[Windsor Hills, California]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/losangeles/news/multiple-people-injured-in-fiery-crash-in-windsor-hills-neighborhood/ (CBS)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The Biden administration declares the ongoing [[monkeypox]] outbreak to be a [[public health emergency (United States)|public health emergency]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/biden-administration-declares-monkeypox-a-public-health-emergency/ar-AA10jmK8 (MSN)]
***The [[United States Food and Drug Administration]] announces that it will permit the use of [[Bavarian Nordic]]'s [[Jynneos]] vaccine in children on a case by case basis. [https://abcnews.go.com/GMA/Wellness/monkeypox-vaccine-kids-case-case-basis-fda/story?id=87924596 (ABC News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in South Africa]]
****[[South Africa]] reports its first death linked to the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] in a person who received the [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-africa-reports-first-death-causally-linked-covid-vaccine-2022-08-04/ (Reuters)]
